rows.label: Installation costs (Mali)
rows.explainer: This is the cost quoted by Uduma in October 2024 to reach 100% of its expected customers with chlorination by 2028. This includes the costs of purchasing chlorination equipment, installation costs, staff costs, training and travel. It excludes the ongoing costs of operating chlorination systems over time.

Total number of person-years of ILC coverage over 10 year timespan (Mali)
Adjustment to account for customer number overreporting
rows.explainer: This is a rough adjustment to account for our best guess that Uduma is more likely to overestimate the number of people reached by its water points than underestimate them. One factor informing this estimate is that Uduma's estimate of customers per handpump (400 on average) is significantly higher than Evidence Action's estimates of households served by each of the dispensers in its Dispensers for Safe Water Program (119 to 260, varying by country). We only put limited weight on this data because there may be differences in water infrastructure and the communities served in Uduma-managed locations, which are all in different countries to Evidence Action's programs.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
